spec.description: Fetch the items and profiles that changed most recently.

response.title: Updates
response.description: What has changed since the last time this was read: what a mirror polls to stay current.

items.description: Ids of the items that changed.

profiles.description: Usernames of the profiles that changed.

notes: An item is "changed" for any reason at all -- an edit, a new comment underneath it, a score move -- so this is a hint about what to re-fetch, not a diff.
